wins.label: Strong Q3 Results
wins.evidence: This morning, we reported another very good quarter with net income of $3.8 billion and earnings per share of $1.86, with an ROTCE of 8%.

wins.label: Improved Operating Leverage
wins.evidence: We continue to generate positive operating leverage for the firm and in each of our 5 businesses.

wins.label: Strategic Investments in Technology
wins.evidence: We are committed to embedding AI into how we work. Nearly 180,000 colleagues in 83 countries now have access to our proprietary AI tools.

wins.label: Client Growth and Retention
wins.evidence: We had record net new investment assets of $18.6 billion in the quarter and client investment assets increasing by 14%.

wins.label: Capital Return to Shareholders
wins.evidence: We returned over $6 billion in capital to our common shareholders during the third quarter.

risks.label: Regulatory Uncertainty
risks.evidence: We are still waiting for clarity from the Federal Reserve on whether the averaging of SCB results from the previous 2 consecutive years will become effective in the next few months.

risks.label: Economic Volatility
risks.evidence: There are pockets of valuation frothiness in the market, so I hope discipline remains.

risks.label: Credit Risks
risks.evidence: Our reserves continue to incorporate an 8-quarter weighted average unemployment rate of 5.2%, which includes a downside scenario average unemployment rate of nearly 7%.

risks.label: Transformation Costs
risks.evidence: Transformation expense for 2025 is expected to be under $3.5 billion, and it will take time to see the full benefits.

risks.label: Banamex Exit Uncertainty
risks.evidence: The agreement with Fernando Chico Pardo to purchase a 25% equity stake is a very significant step towards the divestiture of Banamex and progresses the overall time line to deconsolidation and beyond.

wins.label: Record Third Quarter Results
wins.evidence: Net income of $3.8 billion and earnings per share of $1.86, with an ROTCE of 8%.

wins.label: Adjusted EPS Growth
wins.evidence: Adjusted EPS was $2.24 with an adjusted ROTCE of 9.7% excluding goodwill impairment.

wins.label: Revenue Growth Across Businesses
wins.evidence: Revenues were up 9% and every business had record third quarter revenue and improved returns.

wins.label: Strong Operating Leverage
wins.evidence: The firm continues to generate positive operating leverage for the firm and each of its 5 businesses.

wins.label: Significant Capital Return
wins.evidence: Returned over $6 billion in capital to shareholders during the third quarter.

risks.label: Macroeconomic Uncertainty
risks.evidence: The macro environment reflects a global economy that has proved more resilient than many anticipated. The U.S. continues to be a pacesetter, driven by consistent consumer spending as well as tech investments in AI and data centers.

risks.label: Market Volatility
risks.evidence: There are pockets of valuation frothiness in the market, so I hope discipline remains.

risks.label: Labor Market Dynamics
risks.evidence: Growth is cooling somewhat and we are keeping an eye on the labor market.

risks.label: Regulatory Scrutiny
risks.evidence: The regulatory environment reflects changes in the reg environment coming from D.C., and I think like everyone we welcome the proposed changes, including recalibration to center on safety and soundness.

risks.label: Banamex Deconsolidation Risks
risks.evidence: The agreement with Fernando Chico Pardo to purchase a 25% equity stake in Banamex.
